name: design-kit
summary: Route UI design work across Mobbin references, DesignMD design systems, 21st.dev components, and v0 generated drafts, with an access check, a cost rule, and a per-decision source record.
side_effects: metered provider calls (21st code retrieval, DesignMD reads, v0 generations)
project file changes when installing components
provider writes only on request (Mobbin collections, v0 deployments)
triggers: pick a design system for this app
generate a UI draft with v0
exclusions: live ui audit of a running app
publishing or deploying without the user's request
